name: api-spring-boot
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: API with Spring Boot
description: Spring Boot with Java 17, Maven, Web, Validation and Actuator: a production-ready REST API from the first commit.

base.command: curl -fsSL https://start.spring.io/starter.tgz -d type=maven-project -d language=java -d javaVersion=17 -d dependencies=web,validation,actuator -d groupId=com.example -d artifactId={{name}} -d name={{name}} -d baseDir={{name}} | tar -xzf -

instructions:
## How to work here

- Code in `src/main/java`, in layers: `controller` (HTTP), `service` (logic) and `repository` (data).
- Validate input with `@Valid` and Bean Validation; return DTOs, never entities.
- Configuration in `src/main/resources/application.properties`; secrets through environment variables.
- Start with `./mvnw spring-boot:run`. Before finishing: `./mvnw test`.
